mainEntity.name: How do I contact AirPal.Me support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Write to us from the contact page, or email hello@airpal.me or AirPalMe@gmail.com directly. AirPal.Me is operated from Sydney, Australia by SarvamDaily Pty Ltd — we read every message and aim to reply within 30 days.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to get help?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. On the airpal.me website you can read the help guides and contact us without signing in. The native iOS and Android apps require an account.

mainEntity.name: I scanned an arrival or precinct QR code — where is my help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the Resident arrival guide or help center for scans, check-in, cohorts, and ticketing. For anything about your room or building booking, ask the residence reception directly.

mainEntity.name: How do I report someone or stay safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use report and block inside the app — every safety case gets human review. Meet in public places and keep chat and payment inside AirPal.Me. No marketplace where people meet in real life can guarantee personal safety, so in an emergency call your local emergency number.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a copy of my data or delete it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose “Copy of my data” or “Delete my data” as the topic on the contact page, and read the privacy policy for how we handle your information.
